observedBehaviour: A shape container centres a child that fits, but top-clamps one taller than itself rather than centring it. The two centres then differ by exactly half the overflow.

minimalReproduction.arrangement: A 13.8 pt paragraph positioned CENTER_LEFT in a 6.8 pt band at three vertical offsets.

workaround: Offset each over-tall child upward by its own overflow, derived from the two box heights - never a number tuned by eye against today's text.

sourceRun.note: Surfaced when shrinking a band to fix a timeline rail moved the job title inside it.
